model_annotations.Bulgarian: Figure 5 (left) illustrates the proportion of SDPA output values that fall below a specified threshold after the application of gating, comparing this proportion across different layers of a neural network. The horizontal axis, labeled "Layer," represents the layer number, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, marked at intervals of 5. The vertical axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," represents the proportion of values below the threshold, with a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0, marked at intervals of 0.2. The figure contains three distinct lines: a solid black line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03," which remains relatively flat at a value of approximately 0.03 across all layers; a dashed black line for the "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," which starts at a value of approximately 0.44 at layer 0 and increases steadily to a value of approximately 0.8 at layer 20; and a dotted black line for the "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.13," which begins at a value of approximately 0.13 at layer 0 and increases to a value of approximately 0.3 at layer 20.

model_annotations.English: Figure 5 (left) is a line plot that illustrates the proportion of SDPA output values that fall below a specific threshold (1e-2) across different layers of a neural network. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," represents the layer number and ranges from 0 to 20 on a linear scale, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," represents the proportion of values below the threshold and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains three distinct lines, each representing a different condition: "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03" (a solid green line), "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44" (a dashed green line), and "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.13" (a dotted green line). All three lines show a general downward trend as the layer number increases. The "before gate" line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.03 and remains relatively flat. The "after gate" line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.8 and decreases to about 0.05. The "after average gate" line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.6 and decreases to about 0.03.
